title: External Observers May See More Clearly: Cross-Model Span-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Hidden State Probing
abstract: arXiv:2610.02066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as foundational reasoning engines, their tendency to hallucinate remains a critical vulnerability. While recent internal state probes offer a promising alternative to slow external retrieval systems, they largely reduce hallucination detection to a token-wise binary classification task, failing to capture the structured, sequential boundaries of semantic drift. Here, we introduce an internal hidden state framework for fine-grained, span-level hallucination detection. By inspecting layer-wise activation patterns, we attempt to detect the exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens in an LLM generation. Our experiments show that this approach successfully isolates hallucination onsets, achieving substantial improvements in Precision-Recall AUC over random baselines despite extreme class imbalance. translated_title: 旁观者清：基于隐状态探测的大语言模型跨模型片段级幻觉检测
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLMs）日益成为基础性的推理引擎，其产生幻觉的倾向仍然是一个关键性弱点。尽管近期的内部状态探测方法为缓慢的外部检索系统提供了有前景的替代方案，但它们大多将幻觉检测简化为逐词元的二分类任务，未能捕捉语义漂移的结构化、序列化边界。在此，我们提出了一种用于细粒度、片段级幻觉检测的内部隐状态框架。通过检查逐层激活模式，我们试图检测大语言模型生成过程中幻觉确切的发生词元和延续词元。我们的实验表明，该方法能够成功分离出幻觉发生点，在类别极度不平衡的情况下，精确率-召回率AUC相比随机基线仍取得了显著提升。最终，我们提出了一种新颖的跨模型检测框架，其中一个模型可以观察另一个模型的内部状态。
tldr: 提出了一种基于内部隐状态逐层探测的细粒度片段级幻觉检测框架，能够精确定位大语言模型生成中幻觉的发生与延续词元，并进一步构建了跨模型检测框架以实现“旁观者清”式的幻觉识别。
